protocol.name: conpositor_lua_unstable_v1
protocol.description: This protocol is used to run lua code in conpositor.

interface.name: conpositor_lua_runner_v1
interface.description: This interface is used to run lua code in conpositor.

event.name: print
event.description: Signals that the lua command has printed something.

event.name: fail
event.description: Signals that the running lua code has failed.

event.name: success
event.description: Signals that the running lua code has finished execution.

event.name: return
event.description: Signals that the running lua code has finished execution and returned a value.
